notification.welcome: Welcome to **Claude**! Go to the app settings to configure your Anthropic API key.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Anthropic API key. You can find or create one at platform.claude.com.

model.title: Default Model
model.description: The Claude model to use by default. Individual flow cards can override this.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in Claude's response. Higher values allow longer responses.

homey_mcp.title: Homey MCP
homey_mcp.description: Connect to your Homey via MCP to give Claude access to your devices and flows. After connecting, use the "Ask Claude with Homey context" flow card.

system_prompt.title: Default System Prompt
system_prompt.description: An optional system prompt that is sent with every request. Use this to give Claude a persona or set behavioural guidelines. Leave empty to use no system prompt.
system_prompt.placeholder: You are a helpful home assistant...

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Reusable instructions Claude can load for a task. Pick a skill on the "with a skill" flow cards. Skills are stored in your Anthropic workspace.
skills.name: Name
skills.summary_placeholder: When Claude should use this skill.
skills.instructions_placeholder: How Claude should carry out the task.
